origin: proposed synthetic operation map, not inspected production source
assumptions: Two monotonic generations, one broker connection and one resource.
The external effect service may finish cleared work after sender death or disconnect.
A surviving revoker has its own connection. Disconnect does not execute SQL.
Safe abstraction assumes generation comparison and effect are indivisible at the resource service; all reassignments use that same mechanism.
omissions: Actual database isolation, network delivery, restart and reconnect, and resource-service implementation are not reproduced.
